isolation: Each main case starts a fork_turns=none sub-agent; G04 turn 2 continues same case after turn 1 artifacts. No cross-condition files authorized.
configuration: All execution agents inherit the same parent model and reasoning defaults with no override; exact backend revision, temperature and token caps are not exposed and cannot be independently confirmed.
tools: Local file read/write and shell; no web, user contacts, other skill packages or delegation.
knowledge_difference: Old/new include their respective bundled knowledge references and renderer; basic includes only supplied business evidence and model knowledge. Comparison measures total package conditions, not pure prompt causality.
output: HTML and JSON per main case turn; actual generated files required; field names unconstrained for fairness.
constraints: Synthetic tasks, simulated agents; not real operators, native routing or real business efficacy.
